latest_release.name: v1.6.2 — Comfy SDK, Router, and clip cards
latest_release.body:
# Calliope 1.6.2 — Comfy SDK, Router, and clip cards

## Local workflows go through the Comfy SDK

A workflow job is still a row in Calliope's queue. After the graph is patched, the worker submits it with `comfy-sdk` to `comfy-api-proxy`, which fronts your ComfyUI on port 8188.

Start the proxy while ComfyUI is already running:

```bash
pip install comfy-api-proxy
comfy-api-proxy --comfyui http://127.0.0.1:8188 --port 8189
```

**Settings → Comfy → Comfy API URL** defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:8189`. Role tags and prompt profiles are unchanged. If the proxy is down, the job fails and names both URLs. Dry-run still never opens an SDK client.

## Comfy Router is optional

Router calls `https://api.comfy.org`. It does not use the proxy.

1. Settings → Comfy → save a **Comfy API key**.
2. Turn on **Use Comfy API provider (Router)**.

The pickers then offer **Comfy Router · MiniMax H3** (Video, and the canvas `@` menu) and **Comfy Router · FLUX 3** (Assets). The worker downloads the result into your assets folder immediately. No key, or the switch left off, keeps every job on your imported workflows.

## Project canvases show each clip

Each clip is its own card, labeled `#3.2` with the scene heading underneath. Lines run from that scene's characters and location to every one of its clips. The scene card keeps the environment still. A finished clip render stays on the clip card instead of adding a second copy. A sandbox canvas has neither the cards nor the lines.

The agent also remembers the workflow you already picked in the session, so a later "yes, generate" does not ask you to choose it again.

Full notes: [Comfy SDK, Router, and clip cards](https://github.com/benjiyaya/Calliope/blob/v1.6.2/docs/changelogs/2026-10-28-sdk-router-canvas-clips.md)

Setup: [Comfy SDK and Router](https://github.com/benjiyaya/Calliope/wiki/Comfy-SDK-and-Router)
